fixed.summary: A box with cut corners (corner-shape: bevel, notch, squircle or a superellipse) no longer takes an extra painter level for its shadow: its shadow's bounds end where a round box's do, so text above a bevelled button or panel stays in the level below it. A style with bevelled controls drew the default sample in five levels instead of four.
A control state cleared with background: none draws no fill under any corner shape; under a bevelled corner it submitted a fully transparent shape.
